candidates.title: DyCoke : Dynamic Compression of Tokens for Fast Video Large Language Models
candidates.abstract: Video large language models (VLLMs) have significantly advanced recently in processing complex video content. Yet, their inference efficiency remains constrained because of the high computational cost stemming from the thousands of visual tokens generated from the video inputs. We empirically observe that, unlike single image inputs, VLLMs typically attend visual tokens from different frames at different decoding iterations. This makes a one-shot pruning strategy prone to removing important tokens by mistake. Motivated by this, we present DyCoke, a training-free token compression method to optimize token representation and accelerate VLLMs. DyCoke incorporates a plug-and-play temporal compression module to minimize temporal redundancy by merging redundant tokens across frames and applying dynamic KV cache reduction to prune spatially redundant tokens selectively. It ensures high-quality inference by dynamically retaining the critical tokens at each decoding step. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that DyCoke can outperform the prior SoTA counterparts, achieving 1.5× inference speedup, and 1.4× memory reduction against the baseline VLLM, while still improving the performance, with no training.
candidates.reason: LLM推論の対象である動画対応VLLMについて、入力される大量の視覚tokenによる計算・メモリ負荷を推論時のtoken圧縮で下げる研究である。学習不要の二段階方式を提案し、複数の動画QA・動画説明ベンチマークでLLaVA-OneVisionを評価しているため、推論効率化の対象に該当する。過剰なpruningでは精度が低下することも報告されており、適用範囲は動画VLLMの視覚token処理である。
candidates.library_body_check: arXiv本文の§3.1–3.2でprefillとdecodeの流れ、および方式を確認。TTMは近接frame間のcosine類似度に基づいて時間的に重複するvisual tokenをprefill時にmerge/pruneし、続くdecode時のdynamic KV-cache pruningは評価layerのattention上位tokenを残し、除いたtokenをDP cacheに保持してattention分布が変化した時に再評価・復帰させる。§4.1ではLLaVA-OneVision 0.5B/7B/72B、RTX 4090/A6000/A100およびActivityNet-QA、NextQA、PerceptionTest、VideoMME、VideoDC、MVBenchによる評価設定を確認。§4.2–4.3とTables 1–6では各種QA/説明指標、token/FLOPs比、latency・memoryを比較し、7Bで最大約1.54xの速度向上と結論部で最大1.4xのmemory削減を報告する一方、短・中尺動画で改善が見られ、長尺動画で同等以上とは限らないこと、過剰pruningやone-shot pruningで性能が落ちることを確認。結論および§4.4のablationも確認。一次本文に基づき採択。対象は動画VLLMの視覚token圧縮であり、一般のtext-only LLM圧縮・serving全般の評価ではない。

candidates.title: Janus: Multi-LLM Serving at Production Scale
candidates.venue: Proceedings of the ACM SIGOPS 32nd Symposium on Operating Systems Principles
candidates.abstract: Production LLM serving multiplexes hundreds of heterogeneous models on shared clusters, exposing three challenges that existing systems fail to address simultaneously: unpredictable bursts, power-law application popularity, and heterogeneous yet complementary resource demands. We present Janus, a Service-Engine co-designed multi-model serving system built around dual-timescale scheduling. At the Service layer, a Model Scheduler driven by a Performance Oracle combines vector bin-packing every 30 seconds for steady-state colocation with elastic scaling every 0.5 seconds. A new LST-IMH Request Scheduler maximizes SLO attainment with a proven 2-approximation guarantee. At the Engine layer, xTensor virtualizes HBM, while a three-state model lifecycle and device-to-device (D2D) fork enable elastic multi-model colocation and sub-second burst scale-out. We deploy Janus on a 768-device production cluster serving 62 applications and 45.6 M requests/day, and evaluate it with a 603 K-request open-loop replay sampled from that production day. Janus maintains 0.97-1.0 SLO attainment, versus 0.80-0.92 for the strongest baseline, while using 13,440 device-hours/day, 27% less than static Serverless-LLM. Janus is available as open source at https://github.com/Janus2026/Janus.
candidates.reason: LLM推論を担う複数の異種モデルを本番MaaSクラスタで効率的に共存・配置・スケールするservingシステムを提案する。Service–Engine協調の二層設計、負荷に応じた配置・要求スケジューリングと推論実行時のHBM共有・モデル複製を統合し、推論サービングのSLO達成とデバイス使用効率を実測評価しているため対象に含める。
candidates.library_body_check: 一次資料PDF（著者公開版 https://yangtonghome.github.io/uploads/Janus_SOSP2026.pdf）の§2.2–3で、62アプリの本番traceから秒単位のburst、application popularityの偏り、HBM容量・計算・帯域の異質性を分析し、Steady/Elasticのdual-poolを導く点を確認。§4はPerformance OracleのGaussian Process、30秒周期のvector bin-packing、0.5秒周期のelastic scaling、およびon-time request数に2近似保証を持つLST-IMHを記述。§5–6はweights/KV cache/activationsを同じ仮想HBM page poolで管理するxTensor、active/warm/cold lifecycle、H2D wakeupとD2D fork、およびxLLM上の実装を説明。§7ではHuawei CloudMatrix 384 supernode上の768 Ascend 910C diesで、45.6M request/dayの本番traceから抽出・圧縮した603K request replay等を評価し、Janusが0.97–1.0 SLO attainmentとServerlessLLM比27%少ないdevice-hoursを達成、671B replicaのD2D forkが0.74秒（H2D 2.71秒）と報告。§9はdual-pool単体比較、xTensorのresident density/fragmentationも要約する。限界・適用範囲として、主なend-to-end評価は特定のCloudMatrix/Ascend環境で行われ、trace replayは本番日のsampleを約30分へ圧縮した条件であることを確認。
